description: Implementation of AccountTransfersReadPlatformService handling account transfer data retrieval, templates, and related database operations within the Fineract project.

classes.name: AccountTransfersReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for handling account transfer data retrieval, templates, and database operations in Fineract.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Prepares a template for account transfer, fetching relevant account, client, and office data based on provided IDs and types.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of account transfer data based on search parameters and optional account detail ID.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Fetches a specific account transfer record by its ID.

methods.name: fetchPostInterestTransactionIds
methods.description: Fetches transaction IDs for interest transfers associated with a specific account.

methods.name: fetchPostInterestTransactionIdsWithPivotDate
methods.description: Fetches transaction IDs for interest transfers after a specified pivot date.

methods.name: isAccountTransfer
methods.description: Checks if a transaction ID corresponds to an account transfer of a specific account type.

methods.name: retrieveByStandingInstruction
methods.description: Retrieves account transfer data associated with a specific standing instruction ID.

methods.name: retrieveRefundByTransferTemplate
methods.description: Prepares a refund transfer template, similar to retrieveTemplate, for refund scenarios.

methods.name: getTotalTransactionAmount
methods.description: Calculates total transaction amount for an account on a specific date.
